slots.name: economic dialogue launch date
slots.sentence: The U.S.-Taiwan Economic Prosperity Partnership Dialogue, launched in 2020; the U.S.-Taiwan Initiative on 21st Century Trade, initiated in 2022; and the recently concluded Agreement on Reciprocal Trade have significantly broadened bilateral engagement.

slots.name: trading partner rank
slots.sentence: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence has dramatically increased demand for Taiwan’s semiconductors and other advanced technologies, helping propel Taiwan to become the United States’ fourth-largest trading partner, up from eighth only a few years ago.
